name: One_with_the_Shield
display_fullname: Council SuperSoldier One with the Shield
display_help: When you activate this power, you gain strong resistance against most types of damage and also to Disorient, Immobilization, Hold, Knockback, Repel and Sleep effects. One with the Shield costs little Endurance to activate and increases your recovery and maximum hit points for its duration, but when it wears off you are left exhausted, and substantially drained of Endurance.
display_short_help: Self +Res(Disorient, Sleep, Hold, Immobilize, Repel, Knockback, All DMG but Psionics), +Recovery, +MaxHP, Delayed Weaken(Self -End)
